description: This file defines the interface and factory for the ControlIpc class used in the Rialto client for IPC communication. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and references to external protobuf-generated classes, focusing on control message handling and event subscription.

classes.name: ControlIpcFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of ControlIpc, implementing the IControlIpcFactory interface.

classes.name: ControlIpc
classes.description: Implements the IControlIpc interface for IPC communication, handling control messages and events.

methods.name: getControlIpc
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to an IControlIpc instance for a given control client.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates a shared pointer to a new ControlIpcFactory instance.

methods.name: getSharedMemory
methods.description: Retrieves shared memory file descriptor and size.

methods.name: registerClient
methods.description: Registers the client with the server.

methods.name: createRpcStubs
methods.description: Creates RPC stubs for control APIs.

methods.name: onApplicationStateUpdated
methods.description: Handles application state change events from the server.

methods.name: onPing
methods.description: Handles ping events from the server.
